about: A snapshot of the main mod's flying bodies and donor flyers, kept as input for the future main-mod adapter pack; this repository never reads the other checkout. Rows copied verbatim from the Lore Disasters repository's staged donor closures (mod/assets/vendored_chars/<closure>/tsv/db/<table>/<fragment>.tsv): battle_entities rows that fly (fly_speed > 0, type not fauna; every column, with the source's header and #table;version marker), and the land_units / mounts rows whose animation table is a flight table of the installed game (one with slot 104), as (unit key, animation table, battle entity). Read by tools/pipelines/air_dive.py (body sizes, rider census) through tools/lib/main_mod_flyers.py, and by tools/tests/test_air_dive_charge_speeds.py. Change it only by taking the snapshot again.

selection.battle_entities_tables: fly_speed > 0 and type not in air_dive_rules.EXCLUDED_TYPES
selection.land_units_tables / mounts_tables: animation table carries slot 104 in the installed game
